releaseNotes: v1.6.16: Navigation fix. Cancel, Add source and Remove now go back through the hub's normal page navigation, so going into Add source and cancelling repeatedly no longer leaves the app's pages out of order. Thanks to vurvantsev. No Done needed. v1.6.15: Clearer device settings. The battery check, poll and snapshot descriptions are shorter and name the setting they depend on, instead of saying "above" or "below", which didn't match the device page layout on a computer or a phone. No Done needed.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Reolink Integration
apps.description: Manages Reolink sources (standalone cameras, NVRs, Home Hubs) and creates camera/doorbell child devices.

drivers.name: Reolink Camera
drivers.description: Component driver for a standard Reolink camera channel.

drivers.name: Reolink Doorbell
drivers.description: Component driver for a Reolink doorbell channel, adds the button-press (visitor) event.

drivers.name: Reolink Device Bridge
drivers.description: Internal, one per source: holds the real-time event connection and parents its camera/doorbell devices. Created by the app.

drivers.name: Reolink Standalone Devices
drivers.description: Internal group device: nests every standalone (non-Hub) camera/doorbell bridge together in the Devices list. Created by the app.
